**Job Overview**




 We are looking for an experienced
 **SAP BRIM SOMCI Functional Consultant** 
 with 7–8 years of hands\-on experience in SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM), particularly in Subscription Order Management (SOM) and Convergent Invoicing (CI).
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong functional and configuration expertise in SAP BRIM and SAP S/4HANA, along with experience in end\-to\-end BRIM implementations, subscription management, high\-volume usage\-based billing, and revenue management.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and testing SAP BRIM solutions while collaborating with business stakeholders, technical teams, data migration teams, and external system providers.
 



 Experience integrating SAP BRIM with non\-SAP CRM platforms, payment gateways, and real\-time payment processing systems is essential.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 1\. SAP BRIM Functional Design \& Implementation
 


* Architect, design, configure, implement, and test SAP BRIM solutions, particularly Subscription Order Management (SOM) and Convergent Invoicing (CI).
* Design end\-to\-end business processes for subscription management, consumption\-based billing, invoicing, and revenue management.
* Configure SAP BRIM functionalities to meet specific business and billing requirements.
* Work with SAP S/4HANA and related modules, including SOM, CI, Sales and Distribution (SD), Materials Management (MM), and Convergent Charging (CC).
* Follow SAP best practices and minimise unnecessary customisation.
* Provide functional advisory and implementation support for high\-volume, usage\-based billing models.



  





 2\. Business Requirement Gathering \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead business workshops to gather, analyse, and document functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Collaborate with business owners, project sponsors, technology teams, vendors, and clients.
* Ensure requirements and proposed solutions are reviewed and approved by business stakeholders.
* Independently manage assigned functional activities and implementation deliverables.



  





 3\. SAP BRIM Configuration \& Integration
 


* Perform hands\-on configuration of SAP BRIM modules, especially SOM and CI.
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP BRIM, SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA, non\-SAP CRM systems such as Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and external payment gateways.
* Work with technical and integration teams to define APIs, data models, and integration requirements.
* Support integration with mediation systems for usage capture, rating, and billing.
* Ensure data integrity and minimize unnecessary data replication across integrated systems.



  





 4\. Payment Processing \& Security Compliance
 


* Design and support secure payment processing and integration workflows.
* Ensure compliance with PCI DSS requirements and SOC 1/SOC 2 controls.
* Demonstrate expertise in payment tokenization, secure payment flows, and payment gateway integration.
* Support real\-time payment processing through non\-SAP CRM and external payment systems.
* Ensure secure handling of payment\-related information and transactions.



  





 5\. Data Migration \& Cutover Management
 


* Collaborate with data migration teams to define target data mappings and migration strategies.
* Support high\-volume SAP BRIM data migration with minimal business disruption.
* Plan and execute delta data loads during migration and cutover activities.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reconciliation throughout migration.
* Design and support customer dispute management processes for migrated transactions.
* Minimize manual intervention required from business users after migration.



  





 6\. Functional Testing \& Defect Management
 


* Prepare detailed functional test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts.
* Perform functional testing and document test results.
* Review System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts and results.
* Participate in SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect resolution activities.
* Identify functional gaps, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with technical teams for resolution.
* Ensure functional requirements are fully covered by test scenarios.

* Prepare and maintain functional specifications, process flows, solution designs, and configuration documents.

* Review technical specifications prepared by development teams.
* Maintain impact analysis reports, test plans, test scripts, implementation documentation, and lessons learned.
* Follow project documentation standards, SAP best practices, and governance procedures.



  





 8\. Training \& Knowledge Transfer
